plugins.name: gdd-forge
plugins.description: System-based Game Design Document generator: turns a pitch into a short concept, a decision table and one document per game system, asking at most four questions up front; every kit-made choice is a visible proposal, and a deterministic checker plus one independent reviewer check each document.
